## Gemini Embedding 2 Preview API

Gemini Embedding 2 Preview is an embedding model by Google, available on the Venice API as `gemini-embedding-2-preview`. Requests are anonymized, so the provider never sees your identity.

Gemini Embedding 2 Preview is a preview of Google's Gemini-based embedding model, returning 3,072-dimensional vectors for inputs of up to 2,048 tokens. It's built for semantic search, retrieval and classification.

### Gemini Embedding 2 Preview API pricing

| Model ID | Variant | Privacy | Price |
|---|---|---|---|
| `gemini-embedding-2-preview` | Standard | Anonymized | $0.25 / 1M tok |

### Gemini Embedding 2 Preview specifications

| Spec | Value |
|---|---|
| Provider | Google |
| Released | Apr 17, 2026 |
| Privacy | Anonymized |
| Status | Stable |
| Dimensions | 3,072 |
| Max input | 2K tokens |

### How to use the Gemini Embedding 2 Preview API

Send requests to `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/embeddings` with `"model": "gemini-embedding-2-preview"` and your API key.

```bash
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "gemini-embedding-2-preview",
    "input": "Private AI for everyone."
  }'
```
